iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 64. FALLING: Trump claims Iran agreed to hand over enriched uranium 'nuclear dust' - Iran REJECTS claim. Core dispute: US demands 20-year enrichment freeze, Iran offers 5 years. Iran FM: enrichment right 'indisputable' but level 'negotiable'. IAEA locked out 8+ months. 440kg 60% uranium location unknown. JINSA report: main enrichment/weaponization sites damaged by US-Israeli strikes. Polymarket: 39% enrichment agreement by Apr 30, 24.5% by Apr 22. Iran envoy says not looking to enrich to bomb levels. NPT Review Conference Apr 27. Probability 35%. Falling.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 64. FALLING: MAJOR DE-ESCALATION - Iran declares Strait of Hormuz 'completely open' for all commercial vessels following Lebanon ceasefire. Oil crashes 11% from ~$102 to ~$81-86. Trump says war 'very close to over' BUT US naval blockade 'WILL REMAIN IN FULL FORCE AND EFFECT' until deal '100% COMPLETE'. Ceasefire deadline Apr 22 - 4 days. 2nd round talks expected over weekend. CT-ISW warns Iran exploiting ceasefire to regenerate ballistic missile force. Iran pursuing interim agreement for ceasefire extension. France planning Hormuz security conference. South Korea first oil tanker through Red Sea. Despite Hormuz opening, US blockade of Iranian ports continues. Oil ~$81-86. Probability 40%. Falling sharply.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 64. FALLING: 10-day ceasefire in effect, holding. Hezbollah NOT part of agreement. Hezbollah launched 38 attacks before ceasefire, warns against direct Lebanon-Israel talks. Netanyahu: troops remain in Lebanon. US envoy calls ceasefire 'beginning of a road.' Macron backs ceasefire extension. German FM says long-term accords needed, Hezbollah must disarm. Hezbollah promises 'vigilance' during truce. Displaced Lebanese returning to scenes of destruction. 1M+ displaced. Probability 15%. Falling.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: STABLE: Roketsan TAYFUN Block-4 hypersonic missile (Mach-5, 1000km range) entering mass production 2026. Largest defense investment in Republic history ($3B). 300 ER air-launched ballistic missile test planned. Defense spending up 30% to $27.34B. Largest integrated air defense facility in Europe. Pushing EU defense integration. Probability 5%. Stable.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: STABLE: CFR 2026 survey warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely - Tier II risk. Pakistan PM Sharif in Qatar mediating Iran ceasefire. India/Afghanistan reportedly 'unhappy' over US-Iran talks. No new escalations. Probability 6%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 67. RISING: Russian Ambassador confirms first of 64 Finnish F-35A nuclear-capable jets arriving 2026. Finland nuclear weapons vote pending in parliament. Kremlin: Finland 'will pose threat, force countermeasures.' Medvedev: Finland/Sweden 'automatic targets.' Finnish professor warns Finland could be first hit in NATO-Russia war. Danish intel: Russia ready for localized war vs neighbor in 6 months if Ukraine stops. Estonia imposes flight restrictions near Russia border. Last US-Russia nuclear pact expired Feb 2026. Probability 20%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: STABLE: ISW/AEI China-Taiwan Update Apr 17. China changing tactics amid Middle East chaos - escalating with Japan, blocking Philippines from disputed shoal, public KMT outreach ahead of 2028 elections. Xi met KMT Cheng Li-wun. US re-evaluating threat level. Taiwan drawing strategic lessons from Iran war. CBS: China weighing supplying Iran with advanced radar systems. CNN: Taiwanese purchasing property in Thailand as escape plans. Taiwan extended conscription to 1 year. $14B US arms for Taiwan. Probability 33%. Stable.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 63. SUSTAINED: Kim oversaw 3-day weapons test series including cluster-bomb warheads on ballistic missiles. 5-missile test from Choe Hyon destroyer Apr 12. ICBM engine test for US-mainland-capable missile. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. ODNI confirms full US mainland ICBM range. 4th destroyer under construction. No new nuclear test. Probability 10%. Stable.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1168+. STABLE-HIGH: Ukraine long-range drone strikes devastating Russian oil infrastructure - Baltic ports Primorsk/Ust-Luga hard hit, Crimea Feodosia terminal destroyed. Germany invests EUR300M in Ukrainian long-range strike + 5,000 mid-range drones. Russia warns Europe against funding drone production. Russian crude exports from Black Sea limited. Russia launched deadliest aerial attack of 2026 - 17 killed, 100+ wounded. ISW: Ukrainian mid-range strikes hitting Russian air defense 47-78km from frontline. Polymarket: 0.4% ceasefire by Apr 30. IISS: 'escalation, not stalemate.' Patriot shortage critical. Probability 85%. Stable.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: STABLE: 2026 Afghanistan-Pakistan War ongoing since late February. China-mediated ceasefire talks in Urumqi - 2nd round concluded, agreed not to escalate. Temporary Eid ceasefire collapsed. Fighting worst since Taliban 2021. CSIS: Pakistan declared 'open war' against Taliban. PM Sharif in Qatar for regional diplomacy. ORF analysis: crisis drifting from resolution. Probability 8%. Stable.
